This method trains an image-to-triplane encoder to reconstruct a 3D radiance field representation from a single input image by leveraging synthetic data generated by a frozen, pretrained EG3D generator [S1].

The evidence explicitly states that the method trains an image-to-triplane encoder using synthetic data generated by a frozen, pretrained EG3D generator. Specifically, the notes and passages mention: 'Sample a latent vector and pass it through the frozen EG3D generator to yield a triplane T', 'Use the high-resolution image I_512 from the reference camera as input to the encoder E to predict triplane T_hat', and 'Trains the encoder by alternating between reference view supervision and multiview supervision using synthetic data from a frozen EG3D model.' This confirms that the encoder reconstructs a 3D radiance field representation (via the triplane) from a single input image leveraging synthetic data from EG3D.

*   **Trainable Components:** Image-to-triplane encoder $E$, MLP decoder, super-resolution network, dual discriminator (fine-tuned) [S1].
